metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the resource group's region.
Process Manager SCIM API token (Process Manager > My Profile > Access Tokens).
What decides a user's Process Manager roles: their Entra ID department, their Entra ID group memberships, or both.

How Entra ID values become Process Manager role names. dynamic: use the department/group name as-is. mapped: use role-mapping.json in the storage account. entraAppRoles: use the role assignments on an Entra ID Enterprise App (groups/both only).
Application (client) ID of the Enterprise App whose app roles map to Process Manager roles. Only used when mappingMode is entraAppRoles.

managed: add roles from Entra ID and remove only roles this sync gave out (roles added by hand in Process Manager are kept). preserve: only ever add roles. replace: make the user's roles exactly match Entra ID.
How often (in minutes) to check Entra ID for changes.
If true, the first run processes every user, not just users who change after installation.
Storage account for sync progress and role-mapping.json. Created if it does not exist. 3-24 lowercase letters and numbers, globally unique.
Blob container for sync progress and role-mapping.json.
Process Manager SCIM API base URL. Change only if Nintex support tells you to.
If true, only roles that already exist in Process Manager are assigned, so Entra ID never creates new roles. Requires the three processManager* settings.
Process Manager site URL, e.g. https://demo.promapp.com/{tenantId}. No trailing slash. Only used by filterToExistingRoles.
Process Manager service-account username (no MFA). Only used by filterToExistingRoles.
Process Manager service-account password. Only used by filterToExistingRoles.
